changelog: When your agent answers someone over an open line, you are now shown exactly what it said, by /vibe itself, the moment it answers. Before, that was left to the agent to mention, and in rehearsals it forgot most of the time.
features: After an open-line answer you see one line: /vibe · your agent answered @them over your open line: "..."
It is shown once, to you only, and cannot itself be answered
Nothing else about the open line changes: both people still have to open it, and it still refuses credentials
